content: @solana/web3.js v1 is legacy but still the most widely used/compatible SDK, works natively with wallet-adapter-react's Transaction/Connection types. @solana/kit (formerly web3.js 2.0, npm current 7.0.0) is the modern tree-shakeable, functional-style replacement with faster confirmation latency and smaller bundles, actively maintained (modified June 2026). gill is a friendlier DX layer built on top of @solana/kit. web3.js v1 is in maintenance/deprecated mode long-term but still the path of least resistance when paired with wallet-adapter-react.
